_about: Held-out validation pool for the actuation-lever GRADUATION BAR (cec_fullstack.graduation_verdict). NEVER tune the bar thresholds to make these pass -- the bar is consulted only to EVALUATE a threshold change. Each case is a per-rule cross-run tally (the output of rule_tally) with the expected graduate/reject verdict and why. Grown from real adjudicated tallies as runs accrue; the four seed cases below are the boundary the default bar (min_runs=3, min_pairs=8, min_improving_frac=0.75, drc effect floor 2.0) must classify correctly.

cases.name: clear-graduate-drc
cases.why: 4 independent clean runs, all improving drc by >= the 2.0 floor, 8 clean pairs -- the bar's positive boundary

cases.name: reject-too-few-runs
cases.why: strong + consistent but only 2 clean runs (< min_runs 3): not enough independent evidence

cases.name: reject-inconsistent-direction
cases.why: 4 runs, 8 pairs, but only half improve (improving_frac 0.5 < 0.75): a coin-flip, not a real effect

cases.name: reject-effect-too-small
cases.why: consistent direction + enough runs/pairs, but |pooled| 1.0 < the 2.0 drc effect floor: noise-level
